title: Concurrent payments are all accepted - money collected twice, bill header shows once
impact: Cash/receipts recorded that the bill does not reflect; double collection from patient; reconciliation impossible.
steps: Generate OP bill of 500 -> submit 4 'Collect payment 500 cash' requests simultaneously (double-click / two counters).
expected: Exactly one payment accepted; others rejected.
actual: All 4 accepted: 4 receipts (RCPT-...) for 2,000, bill paidAmount stays 500; 12 bills found with payment rows != paidAmount.

title: Refunds can exceed the amount paid; bill paid amount goes negative
impact: Over-refund / cash leakage.
steps: Pay 500 -> raise refund 300 -> raise refund 300 -> approve and issue both.

title: Expired stock accepted into inventory and dispensed to a patient
impact: Patient safety - expired medicine dispensed.
steps: GRN a batch with expiry 30 days in the past -> post GRN -> POS sale of that drug.
expected: GRN rejected or batch quarantined; sale refused.
actual: GRN created and posted; sale PSALE-... completed from the expired batch.

title: GST charged on top of MRP - patient billed above MRP
impact: Overcharging; MRP is tax-inclusive by law (Legal Metrology).
steps: Receive batch with MRP 15 -> sell 10 units.

title: Sales returns can exceed quantity sold
impact: Stock inflation and over-refund.
steps: Sell 10 units -> return 3 -> return 8.
actual: Both returns posted (11 units refunded against 10 sold).

title: Stock adjustment can drive a batch to negative stock
impact: Inventory corruption.
steps: Raise adjustment -100000 on a batch holding ~146 units -> approve.
expected: Rejected - on-hand cannot go below zero.
actual: Approved; batch on-hand became about -99,854 (QA reversed it afterwards).

title: One patient's prescription can be dispensed to a different patient
impact: Wrong-patient medication.
steps: POS sale for patient Bravo with prescriptionId belonging to patient Alpha.

title: A patient already admitted can be admitted again (second bed, second IP number)
impact: Duplicate inpatient records, double bed charges, census errors.
steps: Admit patient -> admit same patient again into another vacant bed.
expected: Rejected - patient has an active admission.

title: Patient can be discharged with an unpaid IP bill; billing clearance ignores the balance
impact: Revenue loss; final-billing control absent. The Rs 5,000 deposit also stayed un-adjusted on the bill.
steps: Admit (deposit 5000) -> add charges -> request discharge -> give Billing clearance while balance 8,500 -> finalize.
expected: Billing clearance and final discharge refused until the bill is settled.
actual: Clearance accepted with balance 8,500; IP-2026-000013 discharged with BILL-2026-000097 unpaid (paid 0).

title: Discharge summary can be e-signed by a non-treating doctor, and in another doctor's name
impact: Medico-legal - wrong signatory on the discharge summary.
steps: Doctor B calls summary/approve with approvedByDoctorId = B, then = A (treating).
expected: Only the treating consultant, signing as themselves, can approve.

title: WHO Surgical Safety Checklist stamped complete with failed safety items
impact: Wrong-site surgery / retained-item risk.
steps: Sign-In with siteMarked=false + complete=true; Sign-Out with instrument count NOT correct + complete=true.
expected: Step cannot be completed until every mandatory item is ticked.
actual: Both steps saved as complete; surgery can proceed/finish.

title: Completed consultation's prescription and diagnosis can be silently overwritten
impact: Clinical record integrity; prescription may already be dispensed.
steps: Complete consultation -> PUT a new prescription (5000 mg QID) and new diagnosis.
expected: Locked, or changed only via an addendum/correction trail.

title: Lab and radiology tests are never billed: no price mapping, zero-rate stub lines, processing not gated
impact: Major revenue leakage; no 'billing verification' before tests.
steps: OP visit -> lab APTT + CT Brain done end-to-end -> generate OP bill.
expected: Tests billed at tariff; processing requires billing.
actual: 0/69 lab and 0/54 radiology tests map to a billing service; OP bill shows consultation only; doctor orders appear as 0.00 stub lines.
retest: Code fixed; OPEN until hospital enters prices/rates (data)

title: OP bill can be generated for a cancelled visit
impact: Billing a visit that did not happen.
steps: Register OP visit -> cancel visit -> generate OP bill.

title: Day-close 'expected collection' ignores issued cash refunds
impact: Cashier always appears short by refunds paid out; reconciliation wrong.
steps: Pay 1000 cash -> refund 400 cash -> read day-close collection.
actual: Collection increased by 1000; full pay-and-refund still adds the full amount.

title: No doctor ownership check on OPD consultation endpoints
impact: Any doctor can start/write another doctor's consultation.
steps: Doctor B calls start-consult / vitals on Doctor A's visit.

title: Reception can open the clinical consultation workspace
impact: Clinical data (diagnosis, notes, Rx) exposed to front desk.
steps: Reception GET /opd/visits/{id}/workspace.

title: Progress notes can be filed in another doctor's name
impact: Authorship of clinical notes not trustworthy.
steps: Doctor B posts a progress note with doctorId = Doctor A.

title: IP doctor lab/radiology orders never reach Lab/Radiology
impact: Inpatient investigations silently not done.
steps: Doctor places Lab order on an admission -> check /lab/orders.
actual: Order-sheet entry only; no lab order (lab orders cannot carry an admissionId).

title: Pharmacy IP issues are not charged to the IP bill
impact: Inpatient medicines dispensed free.
steps: Issue 2 units to admission -> generate IP bill.

title: General Ward and Semi-Private bed charge is 0.00/day
impact: IP stays in those wards bill no bed charge.
steps: Admit to General Ward, transfer to Semi-Private -> generate IP bill.
retest: Code fixed; OPEN until hospital enters prices/rates (data)

title: Admission with an IP bill already raised can be cancelled
impact: Orphaned IP bill / charges.
steps: Admit -> generate IP bill -> cancel admission.

title: Clearance segregation: one permission clears all four departments; Billing cannot clear Billing
impact: Head Nurse signs off Billing and Pharmacy clearances.
steps: Head Nurse clears Pharmacy item; Billing user clears Billing item.
expected: Each department clears its own item only.

title: Approved radiology reports do not appear in the EMR
impact: Doctors cannot see imaging results in the patient record.
steps: Approve a radiology report -> EMR timeline/investigations/procedures.

title: Lab result entry accepts non-numeric and negative values for numeric parameters
impact: Garbage results can be verified/approved.
steps: Enter 'abc' and '-5' for APTT.

title: IP orders, vitals and risk scores are not validated
impact: Unsafe medication orders and implausible observations recorded.
steps: Medication order without dose / ending before start; vitals SpO2 140, Temp 150F, GCS 20; Morse item 999.

title: Implant usage recorded without a serial number
impact: Implant traceability/recall impossible.
steps: Record implant usage with serialNumber=''.

title: Completing surgery posts no theatre/surgeon/anaesthesia charge
impact: OT revenue depends on manual keying.
steps: Complete surgery -> generate IP bill.
expected: OT charge created by OT module.
actual: Only bed lines; OT hours keyed manually.

title: Speed Multi branch has no pharmacy store or vendor
impact: No purchase, GRN, sale or IP issue possible at go-live.
steps: Open /pharmacy/stores in SPEED_MULTI.
actual: None (QA created 'QA Main Pharmacy' and a QA vendor to test).

title: Exact duplicate patient registered without warning at save
impact: Duplicate UHIDs for one person (relies on UI pre-check only).
steps: Register a patient with the same name, DOB and mobile as an existing one.
expected: Blocked or duplicate warning requiring confirmation.

title: No maker-checker on stock adjustments
impact: One person can raise and approve their own write-off.
steps: Pharmacy Manager raises adjustment -> approves it.

title: Blocking a patient does not stop OP registration (documented as deliberate)
impact: Block flag is informational only.
steps: Block patient -> register OP visit.

title: Registration accepts invalid gender and future date of birth
impact: Bad demographic data.
steps: Register with gender 0; with DOB 30 days ahead.

title: Full-name search ('First Last') returns no result
impact: Front desk cannot find patients by full name.
steps: Search 'QATEST Alpha'.

title: No duplicate-order prevention
impact: Duplicate tests/scans and charges.
steps: Same test twice in one order; same test re-ordered while open; same scan twice.

title: Unhandled server errors (HTTP 500) instead of validation messages
impact: Users see 'unexpected error'.
steps: Lab order with unknown test; POS sale with unknown payment mode; radiology schedule time without timezone.

title: Past-dated and out-of-hours bookings accepted
impact: Phantom bookings; queue/token errors.
steps: Schedule scan/OT/appointment in the past; appointment at 03:00 (schedule 08-20); check-in a day early.

title: Modality double-booking allowed and scans cannot be rescheduled once scheduled
impact: Clashes; rescheduling needs cancel + re-order.
steps: Schedule two patients at the same modality minute; reschedule a scheduled item.

title: Discount / concession can be applied without a reason
impact: Weak audit of concessions.
steps: Apply 5% bill discount with empty reason.

title: Same UPI transaction reference accepted on two bills
impact: Duplicate-payment / fraud risk.
steps: Collect UPI with ref QA-UPI-0001 on bill A and again on bill B.

title: Corporate credit bill above the corporate credit limit not blocked or flagged
impact: Unchecked credit exposure.
steps: Corporate limit 1,000 -> mark 2,000 bill as credit.

title: GRN accepts MRP below purchase rate and receipts far above the PO
impact: Selling below cost; over-receipt.
steps: GRN with MRP 5 < cost 8; GRN of 9,999 against PO of 100.

title: Doctor role cannot raise the admission recommendation
impact: Doctors depend on Front Office to raise the request.
steps: Doctor POST /ipd/admission-requests.

title: Implant/consumable usage refused mid-surgery until Billing generates the IP bill
impact: Theatre staff blocked by billing desk.
steps: Start surgery (no IP bill yet) -> record consumable.
actual: 400 'Generate the IP bill ... before recording usage'.

title: Minor validation/reporting gaps
impact: Data quality.
steps: Systolic < diastolic; follow-up date in past; UHID gap after rejected save; unbilled report without dates.
